question: PM Kisan ki 17th kist kab aayegi 2026 me?
answer_html:
PM Kisan ki 17th kist May-June 2026 ke ant tak kisano ke bank khate me DBT dwara bheji jayegi. Kendriya Krishi Mantralaya dwara har chaar mahine me 2,000 rupaye ki kist jaari ki jaati hai. Pichli kist February 2026 me safaltapurvak transfer ki gayi thi. Kist ka paisa prapt karne ke liye kisano ko apna Beneficiary Status online portal pmkisan.gov.in par niyamit roop se check karte rahna chahiye.

  • Eligibility Criteria: 2 hectare tak cultivable land wale sabhi chhote evam seemant kisan.
  • Mandatory Verification: eKYC Status YES, Land Seeding YES, aur Aadhaar Bank Seeding YES hona zaroori hai.
  • Online Status Check Steps: pmkisan.gov.in > 'Know Your Status' > Enter Registration No > OTP Verification.

Yadi aapka Aadhaar bank account se link nahi hai to turant India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) me khata kholkar DBT active karwayen.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide

question: PM Kisan Beneficiary Status online kaise check kare?
answer_html:
PM Kisan Beneficiary Status check karne ke liye pmkisan.gov.in portal par 'Know Your Status' option ka upyog karein. Iske madhyam se aap apni kist ki sthiti, bank account seeding, Land Seeding aur eKYC status ka pata laga sakte hain. Yadi aapko apna Registration Number pata nahi hai, to aap mobile number ya Aadhaar number se apna registration number prapt kar sakte hain.

  • Step 1: Official portal pmkisan.gov.in par jayen aur 'Farmers Corner' section me 'Know Your Status' par click karein.
  • Step 2: Apna PM Kisan Registration Number aur screen par dikha captcha code darj karein.
  • Step 3: 'Get OTP' par click karein aur mobile par aaye OTP ko submit karke apna poora status dekhein.

Status page par dekhein ki 'Eligibility Status' me eKYC, Land Seeding aur Aadhaar Bank Account Seeding teeno ke aage Green Tick (YES) likha hai ya nahi.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide

question: PM Kisan eKYC online mobile se aur OTP dwara kaise kare?
answer_html:
PM Kisan eKYC online karne ke liye official website pmkisan.gov.in par 'eKYC' option par jaakar Aadhaar OTP verify karein. Kendriya Sarkar ne PM Kisan Yojana ki har kist prapt karne ke liye eKYC ko anivarya kar diya hai. Yadi aapke Aadhaar card me mobile number registered hai, to aap ghar ba बैठे bilkul muft me mobile phone se eKYC poori kar sakte hain.

  • Step 1: Official portal pmkisan.gov.in open karein aur home page par 'eKYC' tab par click karein.
  • Step 2: Apna 12-digit Aadhaar Card Number darj karein aur 'Search' button par click karein.
  • Step 3: Aadhaar registered mobile number darj karein aur prapt OTP ko enter karke 'Submit' karein.

Yadi aapka mobile number Aadhaar se link nahi hai, to aap nikatstha CSC (Common Service Centre) jaakar Biometric Fingerprint dwara eKYC karwa sakte hain.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide

question: PM Kisan Naya Registration (New Farmer Registration) online kaise kare?
answer_html:
PM Kisan me Naya Registration karne ke liye pmkisan.gov.in par 'New Farmer Registration' link par jaakar online aavedan karein. Bharat ke sabhi chhote aur seemant kisan jinse paas apani kheti yogya zameen ke dastaavez hain, ve is yojana ke tehat salana 6,000 rupaye ki aarthik sahayata paane ke liye aavedan kar sakte hain.

  • Aavashyak Dastaavez: Aadhaar Card, Zameen ki Khatauni (Khasra/Khata Number), Bank Account Passbook, Active Mobile Number.
  • Step 1: pmkisan.gov.in par jaakar 'New Farmer Registration' chunen aur Rural/Urban Farmer Registration select karein.
  • Step 2: Aadhaar Number, State, Mobile Number darj karke OTP verify karein aur Avedan Farm me zameen ki details bharen.

Form submit hone ke baad Tehsil aur State Level verification hoga. Approved hone par agali kist se aapke khate me 2,000 rupaye aana shuru ho jayenge.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide
keywords: pm kisan naya aavedan kaise kare

question: PM Kisan Beneficiary List 2026 me apna naam kaise dekhe?
answer_html:
PM Kisan Beneficiary List me naam dekhne ke liye pmkisan.gov.in par 'Beneficiary List' tab me apna Rajya, Zila aur Gram chune. Is gaon-war (village-wise) list me un sabhi kisano ke naam hote hain jinhe agali kist ka labh milne wala hai. Aap apne gaon ke sabhi patra kisano ki soochi aasaani se dekh sakte hain.

  • Step 1: pmkisan.gov.in open karke 'Farmers Corner' me 'Beneficiary List' option par click karein.
  • Step 2: Dropdown menu se apna State (Rajya), District (Zila), Sub-District (Tehsil), Block aur Village (Gaon) select karein.
  • Step 3: 'Get Report' button par click karein. Aapke samne poore gaon ke labharthiyon ki soochi aa jayegi.

Yadi is list me aapka naam nahi hai, to apna status check karein aur eKYC ya Land Seeding ki kami ko Krishi Vibhag se sampark karke turant sahi karwayen.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide

question: PM Kisan me Aadhaar Bank Account Se Seeding (DBT Link) kaise kare?
answer_html:
PM Kisan ki kist paane ke liye bank khate ko Aadhaar NPCI Seeding (DBT active) karwana anivarya hai. Sarkar ab kewal Aadhaar-based Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) se hi kist bhejti hai. Yadi aapka bank account Aadhaar se seeded nahi hai, to kist ka paisa bank dwara reject kar diya jayega.

  • Option 1 (Bank Branch): Apne bank ki shakha me jaakar 'Aadhaar NPCI Seeding Form' bharen aur Aadhaar Card ki copy submit karein.
  • Option 2 (IPPB Account): India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) me naya digital khata khulwayen, jisme 48 ghante me automatic Aadhaar DBT seeding ho jati hai.
  • Seeding Status Check: UIDAI portal ya pmkisan.gov.in par 'Aadhaar Seeding Status' check karein.

DBT link hone ke baad PFMS portal dwara aapka account verify hoga aur agli kist sidhe aapke khate me credit ho jayegi.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide
keywords: pm kisan dbt link kaise kare

question: PM Kisan ka paisa bank account me kyon nahi aaya (Failure Reasons)?
answer_html:
PM Kisan ka paisa na aane ke mukhya karan eKYC incomplete hona, Land Seeding NO hona, ya Bank Account me Aadhaar DBT Seeding na hona hain. Yadi aapke status me isme se koi bhi kami hai, to Sarkar dwara Fund Transfer Order (FTO) stop kar diya jata hai. Iske ilawa name mismatch ya Aadhar incorrect hone par bhi kist ruk jati hai.

  • Reason 1 - Land Seeding NO: Zameen ka record online map nahi hai. Tehsil me Khasra jama karke YES karwayen.
  • Reason 2 - eKYC Pending: Portal par Aadhaar OTP ya CSC se Biometric eKYC poori karein.
  • Reason 3 - Aadhaar Bank Not Seeded: Bank jaakar NPCI link karwayen ya IPPB me khata kholain.

Sabhi trutiyon ko sahi karne ke baad agali kist ke sath pichli ruki hui kist ka paisa bhi ek sath khate me aa jata hai.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide
keywords: pm kisan ka paisa kyon nahi aaya

question: PM Kisan Toll-Free Helpline Number aur Contact details kya hain?
answer_html:
PM Kisan Yojana ka official Toll-Free Helpline Number 155261 aur 1800115526 hai, jahan kisan apni shikayat darj karwa sakte hain. Yadi aapko kist na milne, status me galti, ya kisi bhi technical samasya ka samadhan chahiye, to aap is toll-free number par sampark kar sakte hain ya email bhej sakte hain.

  • Toll-Free Numbers: 155261 / 1800115526 / 011-23381092
  • Official Email ID: pmkisan-ict@gov.in / pmkisan-funds@gov.in
  • Online Helpdesk: pmkisan.gov.in par 'Help Desk - Query Form' me jakar apna Aadhaar ya Registration No dalkar ticket raise karein.

Iske ilawa aap apne Zila Krishi Adhikari (District Agriculture Officer) ya Tehsil ke Lekhpal se bhi physical verification ke liye mil sakte hain.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide

question: PM Kisan Yojana ke liye patrata aur eligibility rules kya hain?
answer_html:
PM Kisan Yojana ke liye ve sabhi kisan parivar patra hain jinse paas apani kheti yogya bhoomi (cultivable land) ke vaidh dastaavez hain. Is yojana ka uddeshya chhote aur seemant kisano ko beej, khad aur kheti ki zarooraton ke liye aarthik sahayata dena hai. Apatra logon ko is yojana se bahar rakha gaya hai.

  • Patrata (Eligibility): Bharat ka nagrik hona, kheti ki zameen ka khatauni me naam hona, aur Aadhaar-linked bank account hona.
  • Ineligible (Apatra): Income Tax dene wale, Sarkar/Pensioners (pension > Rs 10,000/month), MP/MLA, Doctors, Engineers, CAs.
  • Family Definition: Ek parivar me Pati, Patni aur unke avayask (minor) bachhe shamil hote hain.

Yadi ek parivar me pati aur patni dono ke naam zameen hai, tab bhi parivar se kewal ek hi vyakti ko is yojana ka labh mil sakta hai.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide

question: PM Kisan Status me Land Seeding NO se YES kaise karwaye?
answer_html:
PM Kisan Status me Land Seeding NO ko YES karwane ke liye apne Tehsil ya Krishi Vibhag me Zameen ki Khatauni aur Aadhaar Card jama karein. Jab tak Land Seeding status YES nahi hota, tab tak Sarkar kist ka paisa jaari nahi karti. Ye jaanch isliye ki jaati hai taaki kewal vastavik zameen wale kisano ko hi labh mile.

  • Step 1: pmkisan.gov.in se apne Beneficiary Status ka printout nikalen.
  • Step 2: Apne Zameen ke Khasra/Khatauni ki naveentam certified nakal aur Aadhaar Card ki copy attach karein.
  • Step 3: Apne Kshetra ke Patwari/Lekhpal ya Zila Krishi Adhikari (DAO) karyalay me dastaavez jama karke portal update karwayen.

Document verification ke 15 se 30 dino ke andar PM Kisan portal par Land Seeding status NO se badalkar YES ho jata hai.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide
keywords: pm kisan land seeding no to yes

question: PM Kisan me Name Correction as per Aadhaar kaise kare?
answer_html:
PM Kisan me Naam sahi karne ke liye pmkisan.gov.in par 'Name Correction as per Aadhaar' option ka upyog karein. Yadi aapke aavedan me bhara gaya naam aur Aadhaar Card me darj naam me thoda sa bhi antar hai, to Aadhaar Verification Status fail ho jata hai aur kist ruk jati hai.

  • Step 1: Official portal pmkisan.gov.in par 'Farmers Corner' me 'Name Correction as per Aadhaar' par click karein.
  • Step 2: Apna Registration Number ya Aadhaar Number aur Captcha enter karke Search karein.
  • Step 3: Screen par dikhe form me Aadhaar Card ke anusar sahi Naam type karein aur 'Update' par click karein.

Update karne ke baad UIDAI database se naam verify hoga aur 7-10 dino me 'Aadhaar Status: Verified' show hone lagega.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide

question: PM Kisan Mobile App se Face Authentication dwara eKYC kaise kare?
answer_html:
PM Kisan Official Mobile App dwara bina OTP aur bina fingerprint ke kewal Face Authentication (chehra dikhakar) eKYC ki ja sakti hai. Ye suvidha un kisano ke liye sabse behtar hai jinse paas Aadhaar linked mobile number nahi hai aur ve CSC center bhi nahi ja sakte.

  • Step 1: Google Play Store se 'PMKISAN Mobile App' aur 'Aadhaar FaceRD App' download karein.
  • Step 2: App me apna Aadhaar / Mobile number dalkar OTP se login karein.
  • Step 3: 'eKYC for Other Farmers' ya 'Self eKYC' par click karke camera se face scan karein aur eKYC complete karein.

Is app ke madhyam se ek kisan apne gaon ke doosre kisano ki bhi Face Authentication se eKYC ghar ba बैठे kar sakta hai.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide

question: PM Kisan me 6000 ke bajaye 12000 rupees salana milenge kya?
answer_html:
Kendriya PM Kisan Yojana ke tehat filhaal 6,000 rupaye salana (2000 ki 3 kist) hi diye ja rahe hain, lekin kuch rajya sarkarein additional top-up de rahi hain. Rajasthan sarkar ne Mukhyamantri Kisan Samman Nidhi ke tehat 2,000 rupaye extra jodkar 8,000 kiye hain, jabki Madhya Pradesh me CM Kisan Kalyan Yojana ke 6,000 milakar kul 12,000 rupaye milte hain.

  • Central PM Kisan: Rs. 6,000 prati varsh (Sabhi Rajyon me).
  • Madhya Pradesh: PM Kisan (Rs 6,000) + CM Kisan Kalyan (Rs 6,000) = Total Rs 12,000/year.
  • Maharashtra: PM Kisan (Rs 6,000) + Namo Shetkari Yojana (Rs 6,000) = Total Rs 12,000/year.

Kendra Sarkar dwara rashii badhane par official ghoshna pmkisan.gov.in portal par jaari ki jayegi.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide

question: Kya pati aur patni dono ko PM Kisan ki kist mil sakti hai?
answer_html:
Nahi, PM Kisan Yojana ke niyamon ke anusar ek hi parivar me pati aur patni dono ko is yojana ka labh nahi mil sakta hai. Sarkar dwara parivar (Husband, Wife and Minor Children) ko ek single unit mana gaya hai. Yadi dono ke naam alag-alag zameen hai, tab bhi parivar me se kewal ek hi vyakti ko 6,000 rupaye salana milenge.

  • Rule Definition: Ek Ration Card / Family Unit se kewal ek labharthi patra hai.
  • Illegal Benefit Penalty: Yadi pati aur patni dono paisa lete hain, to unhe apatra mana jayega.
  • Recovery Notice: Galat tareeqe se liya gaya paisa Sarkar ko online portal dwara wapas refund karna hoga.

Aap Voluntary Surrender portal par jaakar doosre sadasya ka naam swaichhik roop se surreneder kar sakte hain.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide
keywords: husband wife both pm kisan benefit
pm kisan single family member eligibility

question: PM Kisan Voluntary Surrender Scheme kya hai aur surrender kaise kare?
answer_html:
Voluntary Surrender option dwara apatra kisan ya swaichhik kisan PM Kisan Yojana ka labh apni marzi se chhod sakte hain. Yadi koi kisan Income Tax pay karta hai ya sarkari naukri me hai, to vashishth kanooni karwahi se bachne ke liye ve is portal se apna naam swaichha se surrendered kar sakte hain.

  • Step 1: pmkisan.gov.in par 'Voluntary Surrender of PM-Kisan Benefits' link par click karein.
  • Step 2: Apna PM Kisan Registration Number aur Captcha enter karke OTP verify karein.
  • Step 3: Screen par diye gaye Surrender Declaration ko read karein aur Final Submit button dabaen.

Dhyan rahe ki ek baar Voluntary Surrender karne ke baad aapko bhavishya me PM Kisan ki koi kist nahi milegi.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide

question: Income Tax dene wale kisan ko PM Kisan ka labh milta hai kya?
answer_html:
Nahi, pichle aaykar varsh (Income Tax Assessment Year) me Income Tax file karne wale kisano ko PM Kisan ka labh nahi milta. PM Kisan Yojana ke samaveshan niyamon (exclusion criteria) ke tehat Income Tax Payers ko apatra ghoshit kiya gaya hai, chahe unke paas kitni bhi kheti yogya zameen kyon na ho.

  • Exclusion Rule: Koi bhi vyakti ya unke pati/patni jinhone pichle saal Income Tax diya hai, ve apatra hain.
  • Data Matching: PM Kisan portal ko Income Tax Department ke database se directly connect kiya gaya hai.
  • Online Refund: Taxpayers dwara li gayi kiston ko 'Online Payment Refund' portal se wapas karna anivarya hai.

Taxpayers dwara refund na karne par rajya sarkar dwara legal notice jaari kiya ja sakta hai.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide
keywords: income tax payer pm kisan eligibility

question: PM Kisan me Khata Number ya Bank Account details change kaise kare?
answer_html:
PM Kisan me alag se bank account change karne ki zaroorat nahi hai, kyunki bhugtan Aadhaar DBT dwara hota hai. Ab Sarkar kisi bhi khata sankhya (account number) me nahi, balki kisano ke Aadhaar se seeded active bank account me sidhe paise bhejti hai. Aap jis bank me DBT link karwayenge, kist usi me aayegi.

  • Step 1: Jis naye bank account me kist chahte hain (jaise SBI, PNB, IPPB), wahan jaakar Aadhaar Seeding Form bharen.
  • Step 2: Bank dwara NPCI Mapper par aapka Aadhaar link hone par PFMS portal automatic naye bank ko detect kar leta hai.
  • Step 3: pmkisan.gov.in par 'Know Your Status' me jaakar dekhein ki DBT Bank status update hua ya nahi.

Is prakar bina portal par account edit kiye naye bank khate me kist milna shuru ho jati hai.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide
keywords: pm kisan bank account edit process

question: PM Kisan Physical Verification Process kya hai aur ye kyun hota hai?
answer_html:
Physical Verification me Sarkar har saal 5% kisano ki zameen aur patrata ki bhautik jaanch karti hai. Is jaanch ka mukhya uddeshya farzi aavedanon, mrit kisano, aur apatra labharthiyon ko pehchan kar yojana se hatana aur vastavik kisano ko unka adhikar dilana hai.

  • Who Conducts It: Tehsil ke Lekhpal, Revenue Inspector aur Krishi Vibhag ke Adhikari is jaanch ko karte hain.
  • Documents Checked: Zameen ki Khatauni, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, aur Kisan ka Swagoshna Patra (Self-Declaration).
  • Action Required: Adhikari ke aane par apne vaidh dastaavez dikhayen aur verification slip par hastakshar karein.

Physical Verification me patra paaye jane par kisano ke status ko portal par 'Verified' kar diya jata hai.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide

question: Common Service Centre (CSC) se PM Kisan eKYC aur Registration kaise kare?
answer_html:
Aap apne nikatstha Common Service Centre (CSC) jaakar Biometric eKYC aur New Farmer Registration karwa sakte hain. CSC VLE dwara Digital Seva Portal ke madhyam se kisano ki Biometric thumb impression eKYC aur Land document upload kiye jaate hain.

  • Services Available at CSC: Biometric eKYC (Fingerprint Scan), New Registration, Correction of Aadhaar Name, Land Document Upload.
  • Government Service Charge: Biometric eKYC ke liye nirdharit nominal shulk (approx Rs. 15) liya jata hai.
  • What to Bring: Original Aadhaar Card, Zameen ki Khatauni/Khasra nakal, Bank Passbook, Mobile.

eKYC hone ke baad CSC VLE se computerized printout receipt zaroor prapt karein.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide
keywords: csc digital seva pm kisan registration

question: PM Kisan Status me FTO Processed Yes/No aur Waiting for Approval ka kya matlab hai?
answer_html:
'FTO Processed - YES' ka matlab hai ki Fund Transfer Order jaari ho chuka hai aur kist jald hi bank khate me aane wali hai. Yadi status me 'Waiting for Approval by State' ya 'RFT Signed by State Government' likha hai, to iska matlab hai ki aapke dastaavez verified ho chuke hain aur kist ki prakriya chalu hai.

  • Waiting for Approval by State: Rajya Sarkar dwara aapke dastaavezon ki jaanch chal rahi hai.
  • RFT Signed by State: Request for Transfer approve ho gayi hai aur Kendra ko bhej di gayi hai.
  • FTO Processed NO: Bank account seeding ya eKYC incomplete hai. Turant status check karke ise sahi karein.

FTO Processed YES hone ke 2-3 dino ke andar 2,000 rupaye ki kist khate me credit ho jati hai.

Source: pmkisan.gov.in | Last Updated: May 2026 | Read complete details on YojanaSaathi PM Kisan Guide
